A named source-bound historical branch alias profile

splitaligner_legacy_label_profile.Rd

Rebuild coordinates from explicitly named original tree bytes and bind the two user-provided historical tables. No historical numerical analysis is performed.

Usage

audit_splitaligner_legacy_labels(old_ape_file, old_new_file, tree_file, file = NULL)
validate_splitaligner_legacy_profile(profile)
legacy_profile_label_migration(x, profile, to_scheme)

Arguments

old_ape_file, old_new_file

Exact original user tables.

tree_file

One of the three explicitly named original tree sources.

file

Optional new RDS destination.

profile

A source-bound profile.

x

A checked exchange with the exact reference instance and ordered ledger.

to_scheme

An explicit registered scheme list with id and version.

Value

A checked profile or a bound migration. Validation returns the profile invisibly.

Details

Scope is marine302-user-bound-20260908-v1 only. Unknown provenance, tree/ledger mismatch, unrecognized nonbranch records and arbitrary claimed authority are rejected. The exact final semicolon record is preserved separately. This is coordinate agreement for named sources, not all-version or whole-generation-history certification.
